Counting

TuringVote counting and tabulation

Electoral technology for vote counting and results tabulation, traceable from each polling station to the final result.

Turing moves the count from manual tallying to results in minutes. The speed and accuracy of the count shape an electoral authority’s ability to report reliable results.

Secure

Built under a management system certified to ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27701.

Scalable

Ready for processes of any size, from a single institution to an entire country.

Auditable

Every operation leaves a record and can be independently verified.
